ip_digestive_complete.name: Digestive Complete
ip_digestive_complete.key: Per 2 capsules: 600 mg betaine HCl, 80 mg pepsin, 350 mg ox bile and pancreatic enzymes
ip_digestive_complete.src: Amounts and directions: products DB R987 (scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json; catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Designs for Health, Thorne, Standard Process and Apex switch charts): per 2 capsules betaine HCl 600 mg, pepsin 80 mg, ox bile 350 mg, pancreatic enzymes protease 35,000 USP, amylase 35,000 USP, lipase 7,000 USP (the serving line names the enzymes without their units, for space); directions 'Take two capsules with each meal or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Sizes R987 60C, R987L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26 via the DB). A web search on 2026-11-03 shows the nutridyn.com/digestive-complete listing with the same pepsin (1:10,000) 80 mg, betaine HCl 600 mg and ox bile 350 mg and a gelatin capsule (page not opened: nutridyn.com is blocked from this session). Protocol: ND584 5R GI Restoration Program, REPLACE step (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5smw): 'Digestive Complete: 3 capsules per meal for 10 days'. The sheet prints the label dose (2 with each meal) because 3 per meal is above the label. Mayfield (NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R list) names it under Enzyme/HCL; his pearls chapter: 'Digestive Complete: dual-phase acid and enzyme support with ox bile'. Not for an ulcer or gastritis (Asher's protocol, Gmail 16d01aaf2b11528e: 'We do not use the conventional way to increase HCL in patients with ulcers'). PHOTO: only the 160 px chart thumbnail exists in reach (scratchpad products/img/R987.png); the print master is Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R987_Web (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5JyA) or R987L_Web (id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5Jug), content host blocked here. Stage it as build/img-src/R987.png.

ip_gi_integrity.name: GI Integrity
ip_gi_integrity.key: 3 g L‑glutamine, 400 mg DGL, 300 mg aloe, 200 mg slippery elm, 16.1 mg zinc (as zinc carnosine)
ip_gi_integrity.src: Amounts: NutriDyn practice kit GI Integrity handout (repo handouts/nutridyn-practice-kit.pdf, 'IN ONE SCOOP (8.5 G)': L-Glutamine 3 g, Zinc (as zinc-carnosine) 16.1 mg, DGL licorice root 400 mg, Aloe vera leaf gel 300 mg, Slippery elm bark 200 mg, 'Plus glucosamine HCl 1 g, apple pectin 1 g, marshmallow, chamomile, okra, cat's claw, MSM, quercetin and prune. No added sugars.'; 'Do not use if pregnant or nursing.'); products DB R327 agrees (catalog ND143 p.100 prints the Peach Tea panel, R325: 8.5 g scoop, 28 servings; quercetin 100 mg per the Metagenics chart). Size line: flavors only. 28 servings is confirmed only for the 238 g Peach Tea panel (R325); the Berry (R327, 238 g) and Chocolate (R328, 362.9 g) panels are not printed, so no count is printed (recheck 2026-11-03). Label direction 'Mix one scoop with 6-8 ounces of water or as directed by your healthcare practitioner' states no frequency, so the protocol dose applies: ND584 REPAIR step 'Dynamic GI Integrity: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days (1 canister)' and Asher's GI-MAP protocol (Gmail 194b7cdf22b9133b, 2025-01-30, Calprotectin/Zonulin section) 'Mix one scoop (7g) with 6-8 ounces of water twice daily.' The practice kit: 'GI Integrity is the anchor.' URL: web search 2026-11-03 returns nutridyn.com/dyn-gi-integrity (page not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). Photo: build/img-src/R325.png, 1024x1428 text-safe upscale of the 420 px Peach Tea render.

ip_gi_defend.name: GI Defend
ip_gi_defend.key: 2.5 g ImmunoLin (serum‑derived bovine immunoglobulin isolate), from beef serum, not milk
ip_gi_defend.src: Amount: products DB R191 (Microbiome Labs switch chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'ImmunoLin per serving: NutriDyn 2.5 g (1 scoop, IgG content not stated on label)'; directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water or your favorite beverage as a dietary supplement or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Size R191 75 g (ND144 via the DB). 'From beef serum, not milk; no lactose': Carl Neubauer's Nutritional Support Knowledge Base text quoted in Gmail 1808fc68b0c5f647 (2022-05-04): serum-derived bovine immunoglobulin, 'no lactose', and 'Colostrum dairy proteins are sensitizing for many' (scratchpad protocols/raw/notes_gmail.md). Claims: the same text, 'binds these toxins together, making them too large to pass through the gut barrier' and 'promotes healthy immune activation responses in supporting low gut permeability'. Dose: label states no frequency, so the protocol applies: ND584 REPAIR 'Dynamic GI Defend: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days'; GI-MAP protocol (Gmail 194b7cdf22b9133b): 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water ... or mix with Dynamic GI Integrity, twice daily.' URL slug: products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc) and a web search on 2026-11-03 (nutridyn.com/dynamic-gi-defend-r191). PHOTO: build/img-src/R191.png is a 584x640 Lanczos stopgap of a 146x160 thumbnail (SOFT); print master Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R191_Web, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5IqQ.

ip_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.key: 30 billion CFU from 7 strains, including 5 billion S. boulardii, L. acidophilus and B. lactis
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.src: Strains, CFU and directions: products DB R829 (Pure Encapsulations switch chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'NutriDyn 30 billion (7 strains: S. boulardii, L. reuteri, B. lactis, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus, L. gasseri, B. coagulans)'; 'Take one capsule daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; Standard Process chart: S. boulardii 5 billion CFU. A web search on 2026-11-03 shows the nutridyn.com/ultrabiotic-daily-multi-strain listing with the same seven strains (S. boulardii Lynside, L. reuteri LRC, B. lactis UABla-12, L. plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05, Bacillus coagulans UABc-20) and 'dairy-free, vegetarian' (page not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). The serving line names S. boulardii and the two strains ND584 asks for (L. acidophilus and B. lactis, i.e. Bifidobacterium lactis; Bacillus coagulans is not named on the line, so the one 'B.' cannot be read two ways, per the recheck); the full seven are S. boulardii, L. reuteri, L. acidophilus, L. plantarum, L. gasseri, Bifidobacterium lactis and Bacillus coagulans. Sizes R829 30C, R829L 60C. Protocol: Asher's GI-MAP protocol for high zonulin or calprotectin (Gmail 194b7cdf22b9133b) lists Akkermansia Plus, Complete or Daily Multi-Strain; Mayfield's NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R list names UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain under Prebiotic/Probiotic; ND584 REINOCULATE asks for 'a probiotic supplement containing both L. acidophilus and B. lactis', which this formula has (ND584's own example is UltraBiotic Complete, whose only reachable photo is a 160 px thumbnail). The label dose is printed (the GI-MAP email's 2 a day is above the label). Bedtime: NutriDyn 60-day protocol conversion doc ('UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain 1 cap At bedtime'), which also keeps it away from the Remove-step herbs on the Gut Overgrowth sheet. Photo: build/img-src/R829.png, 736x1356 text-safe upscale of the 420 px web render.

ip_gi_restore.name: GI Restore
ip_gi_restore.key: 12 g protein, 2.5 g L‑glutamine, 2.5 g arabinogalactan, 2 g 2'-FL, 200 mg NAC, 18.75 mg zinc
ip_gi_restore.src: Amounts and directions: products DB R326C (catalog ND143 10/1/26 p.101 as read by the Metagenics and Biotics Research switch charts; the catalog prints one panel, Vanilla R326V, 35.78 g scoop, 14 servings): protein 12 g, L-glutamine 2.5 g, 2'-fucosyllactose 2 g, larch arabinogalactans 2.5 g, zinc 18.75 mg, vitamin D3 10 mcg, folate 185.2 mcg DFE, N-acetyl-L-cysteine 200 mg; 'NutriDyn also lists arabinogalactans, 2'-FL, quercetin, aloe, slippery elm, NAC'; directions 'Shake canister before scooping. Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water twice daily or as recommended by your healthcare practitioner.' Size line: flavors only, because the catalog prints 14 servings for the Vanilla panel only (Chocolate R326C, 541.1 g, not printed). '2'-FL' is the DB's 2'-fucosyllactose, a prebiotic; quercetin, aloe and slippery elm are listed without amounts, so they are left off the serving line. Protocol: ND584 RESTORE & RETAIN step 'Dynamic GI Restore: 1 scoop twice daily, from day 11 to day 24 (2 canisters)' (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA5smw), same as the label. Claims: Mayfield pearls chapter (repo onboard/mayfield-pearls.html) 'GI Restore: gut barrier, mucin layer, and prebiotic support'; Asher 2019 (Gmail 16c48293ebbba101): 'Gi Restore is for patients with Leaky Gut or other Inflammatory Bowel Syndromes'. URL: web search 2026-11-03 returns nutridyn.com/dynamic-gi-restore (not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). Daily rhythm: its two scoops REPLACE the GI Integrity + GI Defend shakes on days 11 to 24, so they are listed as '1 serving from day 11' (one serving is one scoop, per the label) and left out of the kit's scoop count, which therefore reads the true daily peak (days 1 to 10: 4 scoops). Stage one as build/img-src/R326V.png and this entry picks it up.
